site.story.a.2.zh: 同一个价，多和空各开一仓
site.story.a.2.en: One price, a long and a short

site.story.a.3.zh: 因为看到了机会，但不赌方向。
site.story.a.3.en: There's an opportunity, but no bet on direction.

site.story.a.4.zh: BTC/USDT 永续合约的 K 线回到 96,000，Dodo 在这条开仓线上同时插下两面旗：绿旗开 1 BTC 多仓，红旗开 1 BTC 空仓。钱一直在你自己的币安子账户里。
site.story.a.4.en: The BTC/USDT perpetual is back at 96,000. Dodo plants two flags on that entry line: the green flag opens a 1 BTC long, the red flag opens a 1 BTC short. The money stays in your own Binance sub-account the whole time.

site.story.a.5.zh: 对冲压低的是单边方向风险，不是全部风险。
site.story.a.5.en: Hedging reduces one-way price risk, not all risk.

site.story.a.6.zh: 示意数据 · 非真实行情 · 不会下单

site.story.b.2.zh:
价格走开，
一边赚，一边亏
site.story.b.2.en:
The price moves:
one side gains, one side loses

site.story.b.3.zh: 锁住了仓位，所以涨跌两边抵消。
site.story.b.3.en: Both sides are open, so the move cancels out.

site.story.b.4.zh: BTC 从 96,000 走到 100,800：多仓浮盈约 +4,800，空仓浮亏约 −4,800，净值基本不动。
site.story.b.4.en: BTC goes from 96,000 to 100,800: the long is up about +4,800, the short is down about −4,800, and net value barely moves.

site.story.c.1.zh: 示意 · 净值 = 钱包余额 + 已实现 + 两侧浮动盈亏
site.story.c.1.en: Illustration · net value = wallet balance + realised + unrealised P&L on both sides

site.story.c.3.zh:
平掉赚钱的一侧，
再把仓位补回
site.story.c.3.en:
Close the winning side,
then open it again

site.story.c.4.zh: 盈利落袋成已实现，补仓让锁仓恢复。
site.story.c.4.en: The gain becomes realised; re-opening restores the hedge.

site.story.c.5.zh: 高位拔起绿旗、平掉多仓，+4,800 变成一枚已实现金币；Dodo 再在 100,800 补开新多仓。红旗没动，约 −4,800 的浮亏还在账上。
site.story.c.5.en: At the high, Dodo pulls the green flag and closes the long: +4,800 becomes a realised gold coin. Dodo then opens a new long at 100,800. The red flag stays put, and its roughly −4,800 unrealised loss is still on the books.

site.story.c.6.zh: 已实现收益 ≠ 账户净增。此刻净值仍约 200,000。
site.story.c.6.en: Realised gains ≠ account growth. Net value is still about 200,000.

site.story.d.2.zh:
已实现的钱，
放进生息池
site.story.d.2.en:
Realised money
goes into the yield pool

site.story.d.3.zh: 闲着的利润不躺着，开始计息。
site.story.d.3.en: Idle profit doesn't sit still; it starts earning.

site.story.d.4.zh: 4,800 买入生息稳定币，按浮动利率计息；两面旗照常插着。演示按 4% 年化、1 秒约等于 1 天累计。
site.story.d.4.en: The 4,800 buys a yield-bearing stablecoin at a floating rate, while both flags stay planted. The demo assumes 4% a year, with 1 second ≈ 1 day.

site.story.d.5.zh: 利率随市场变化，不承诺固定收益。
site.story.d.5.en: Rates change with the market. No fixed return is promised.

site.story.d.6.zh: 示意 · 利息加速演示

site.story.e.3.zh: 只看已实现会高估，要看净值。
site.story.e.3.en: Realised alone overstates it. Look at net value.

site.story.e.4.zh: Dodo 逐行核对：这一轮示意里，账户真正多出来的是利息；兑现只是把浮盈换成已实现，空仓的浮亏抵掉了它。
site.story.e.4.en: Dodo checks line by line: in this example, what the account really gained is the interest. Taking profit only turned an unrealised gain into a realised one, and the short's unrealised loss offset it.

site.story.e.5.zh: 两面旗都还插着：行情剧烈或保证金不足时，仍可能被强平。
site.story.e.5.en: Both flags are still planted: in violent markets or with too little margin, positions can still be liquidated.

site.risk.aria1.en: Where returns come from, and the risks

site.risk.3.zh: 收益从哪里来，风险留在哪里。
site.risk.3.en: Where returns come from, where the risk stays.

site.risk.5.zh: 01生息部分的利息已实现利润转入生息稳定币后计息，利率浮动，可能下降。
site.risk.5.en: 01Interest on the yield holdingRealised profit earns interest once it moves into a yield-bearing stablecoin. The rate floats and can fall.

site.risk.6.zh: 02波动里的兑现与补回每次兑现一侧都要和另一侧的浮亏一起看，单看已实现会高估收益。
site.risk.6.en: 02Taking profit and re-opening in volatile marketsEvery time one side is closed, read it together with the other side's unrealised loss. Realised alone overstates returns.

site.risk.8.zh: 01剧烈行情与强平两侧都占用保证金，行情剧烈或保证金不足时仍可能被强平。
site.risk.8.en: 01Violent moves and liquidationBoth sides use margin. In violent markets or with too little margin, positions can still be liquidated.

site.risk.9.zh: 02资金费率永续合约按周期收付资金费，长期持仓可能持续侵蚀收益。
site.risk.9.en: 02Funding ratesPerpetuals pay or charge funding on a schedule. Holding for long periods can keep eating into returns.

site.risk.10.zh: 03执行偏差滑点、延迟、交易所故障，都可能让成交价偏离预期。
site.risk.10.en: 03Execution gapsSlippage, latency and exchange outages can all move fills away from the expected price.

site.risk.11.zh: 04利率与平台生息利率会变化，稳定币与交易所本身也存在风险。
site.risk.11.en: 04Rates and platformsYield rates change, and stablecoins and exchanges carry their own risks.

site.risk.12.en: Look at net value, not just realised

site.risk.13.zh: 净值你账上真正有多少=钱包余额本金与已实现+多仓浮动盈亏没平，随价格变+空仓浮动盈亏常常是负的+生息部分利率浮动−手续费与资金费持仓期间一直在扣
site.risk.13.en: Net valuewhat you really have=Wallet balanceprincipal and realised+Long unrealised P&Lopen, moves with price+Short unrealised P&Loften negative+Yield holdingfloating rate−Fees and fundingcharged while positions are open

site.risk.14.zh: 看收益时看净值，而不只看已实现。合约交易有亏损风险，亏损可能超出预期。
site.risk.14.en: Judge returns by net value, not only by what's realised. Futures trading can lose money, and losses can be larger than expected.

site.safe.aria1.zh: 资金安全设计：子账户 API、提现权限关闭、交易对白名单
site.safe.aria1.en: Fund safety design: sub-account API, withdrawals off, trading-pair whitelist

site.safe.3.zh: 钱留在你的账户，我们只拿下单权限。
site.safe.3.en: Your money stays in your account. We only get permission to trade.

site.safe.4.zh: 通过你币安子账户的 API 接入，提现权限必须关闭。本页不会让你输入任何密钥，也没有连接任何账户。
site.safe.4.en: We connect through the API of your Binance sub-account, and withdrawals must be switched off. This page never asks for a key and is not connected to any account.

site.safe.5.zh: 子账户，专款专用只划入你愿意用于这套策略的资金，两个账户都在你名下。
site.safe.5.en: A sub-account, just for thisMove in only the funds you want to use for this strategy. Both accounts are in your name.

site.safe.6.zh: API 只开读取与合约交易密钥由你在币安创建并保管；提现、划转出子账户都必须关闭。
site.safe.6.en: API with read and futures trading onlyYou create and keep the key on Binance. Withdrawals and transfers out of the sub-account must be off.

site.safe.7.zh: 提现开着，就拒绝接入接入与运行中持续核对权限，任何一项越界就停下并提示你。
site.safe.7.en: Withdrawals on? We won't connect.Permissions are checked at connection and while running. If anything goes beyond scope, we stop and tell you.

site.safe.8.zh: 交易对白名单，最多 50 个只在你勾选的交易对上下单；白名单限制范围，不限制盈亏。
site.safe.8.en: A whitelist of up to 50 pairsOrders only go to the pairs you tick. The whitelist limits scope, not profit or loss.

site.safe.9.zh: 不能提现 ≠ 没有风险。交易权限本身仍可能带来亏损。取回资金需先平仓，再由你本人在币安里划转。
site.safe.9.en: No withdrawals ≠ no risk. Trading permission alone can still lose money. To take funds back, close positions first, then transfer them yourself on Binance.

site.join.12.zh: 想好要交易的币对，白名单最多 50 个

site.join.15.zh: 放在你自己的币安子账户里，不转给 3dtrading

site.join.17.zh: 账户等级以币安显示为准

site.join.20.zh: 只在你勾选的交易对上下单

site.join.21.zh: 以上是 3dtrading 当前方案的要求，不是币安的通用规则。

site.join.24.zh: 按 3dtrading 当前方案：参与资金不低于 20 万 USDT，币安账户达到 VIP2。这是本方案的参与要求，不是币安的通用规则；方案如有调整，以届时说明为准。
site.join.24.en: Under 3dtrading's current plan: at least 200,000 USDT and a Binance account at VIP2. These are this plan's requirements, not general Binance rules; if the plan changes, the updated terms apply.

site.join.26.zh: 一直在你自己的币安子账户里。我们只通过这个子账户的 API 下单，资金不会转到 3dtrading。
site.join.26.en: Always in your own Binance sub-account. We only place orders through that sub-account's API; funds never move to 3dtrading.

site.join.27.zh: 多空同时持有，是不是就没风险？
site.join.27.en: If I hold a long and a short, is there no risk?

site.join.28.zh: 不是。对冲压低的是单边方向风险；强平、资金费率、滑点与执行偏差、利率变化和交易所风险都还在，亏损可能超出预期。
site.join.28.en: No. Hedging reduces one-way price risk; liquidation, funding, slippage and execution gaps, rate changes and exchange risk all remain, and losses can be larger than expected.

site.join.29.zh: 关闭提现和划转，是不是就安全了？
site.join.29.en: With withdrawals and transfers off, am I safe?

site.join.30.zh: 平台没有直接提走或划出资金的权限，但交易权限仍在，合约交易本身仍可能造成损失。
site.join.30.en: The platform can't withdraw or move your funds, but it can still trade, and futures trading itself can lose money.

site.join.31.en: How do I take my money back?

site.join.32.zh: 先把子账户里的持仓全部平掉，再由你自己在币安里把资金从子账户划转回主账户。API 没有划转和提现权限，这一步只能你本人来做。
site.join.32.en: Close every position in the sub-account first, then transfer the funds from the sub-account to your main account yourself on Binance. The API has no transfer or withdrawal permission, so only you can do this step.

site.join.33.zh: 官网和演示会收集我的 API 密钥吗？
site.join.33.en: Do the website or the demo collect my API key?

site.join.34.zh: 不会。官网没有输入框，不连接币安或任何后台。演示里的绑定页会让你试填 API 密钥，只在本机浏览器里检查格式，不发送、不保存。
site.join.34.en: No. The website has no input fields and connects to neither Binance nor any server. The demo’s linking page lets you try entering an API key; it is only format-checked in this browser, never sent or saved.

site.quiz3.h.zh: 收益、风险、流动性，你更看重哪两个？
site.quiz3.h.en: Return, risk, liquidity: which two matter most to you?

site.quiz3.legend.zh: 最多选两项 · 可取消重选
site.quiz3.legend.en: Pick up to two · untick to change

site.quiz3.o1.zh: 风险：想把波动和回撤控制住
site.quiz3.o1.en: Risk: You want swings and drawdowns kept in check

site.quiz3.o2.zh: 流动性：需要时能把钱取回来
site.quiz3.o2.en: Liquidity: You can get your money back when you need it

site.quiz3.go.zh: 看看 3dtrading 如何串联三者

site.quiz3.n0.zh: 收益回报交易执行 + 生息通常要让出
site.quiz3.n0.en: ReturnPayoffExecution + yieldUsually given up

site.quiz3.n1.zh: 风险波动 · 回撤多空锁仓通常要让出
site.quiz3.n1.en: RiskSwings · drawdownLong–short lockUsually given up

site.quiz3.n2.zh: 流动性取回资金平仓后取回通常要让出
site.quiz3.n2.en: LiquidityGetting money backClose, then withdrawUsually given up

site.quiz3.idle.zh: 选出你最在意的两项，看看通常要让出什么。
site.quiz3.idle.en: Pick the two you care about most and see what usually gets given up.

site.quiz3.s0.zh: 已选收益。再选一项：通常第三项就要让出一些。
site.quiz3.s0.en: You picked return. Pick one more: the third usually has to give a little.

site.quiz3.s1.zh: 已选风险。再选一项：通常第三项就要让出一些。
site.quiz3.s1.en: You picked risk. Pick one more: the third usually has to give a little.

site.quiz3.s2.zh: 已选流动性。再选一项：通常第三项就要让出一些。
site.quiz3.s2.en: You picked liquidity. Pick one more: the third usually has to give a little.

site.quiz3.p01.zh: 收益 + 风险可控，通常让出流动性。比如有锁定期的产品：回报和波动都还可以，但钱要先锁住一段时间。
site.quiz3.p01.en: Return + controlled risk usually gives up liquidity. Think of a product with a lock-up: decent payoff, modest swings, but your money is tied up for a while.

site.quiz3.p02.zh: 收益 + 流动性，通常让出风险。比如随时能买卖的高波动资产：可能涨得多，也可能回撤很深。
site.quiz3.p02.en: Return + liquidity usually gives up risk control. Think of a volatile asset you can trade any time: it may rise a lot, and it may fall hard.

site.quiz3.p12.zh: 风险可控 + 流动性，通常让出收益。比如随存随取的活期：波动小、取用方便，但回报通常偏低。
site.quiz3.p12.en: Controlled risk + liquidity usually gives up return. Think of an instant-access savings account: little swing, easy access, but usually a low payoff.

site.quiz3.max.zh: 最多选两项。先取消一项，再换成别的。
site.quiz3.max.en: Two at most. Untick one first, then pick another.

site.quiz3.mech.zh:
1. 收益来源交易执行：平掉盈利一侧兑现利润；生息：已实现部分买入生息稳定币，利率浮动。
  2. 风险管理多空锁仓：同价开多空，对冲方向波动；强平、资金费率和执行风险仍然存在。
  3. 资金进出钱在你本人的子账户；取回前先平仓，再由你在币安里划转，不是随时无条件可取。

全部打通：把收益来源、风险管理与资金进出串成一套流程。它不是三项同时最优，也不保证收益。
site.quiz3.mech.en:
1. Where return comes fromExecution: close the winning side to realise profit. Yield: the realised part buys a yield-bearing stablecoin at a floating rate.
  2. How risk is managedLong–short lock: open long and short at one price to hedge direction. Liquidation, funding-rate and execution risk remain.
  3. How money moves in and outFunds stay in your own sub-account. To withdraw, positions are closed first, then you transfer on Binance yourself; it is not instant or unconditional.

All connected: return, risk management and money in and out run as one flow. That doesn’t make all three optimal at once, and returns are not guaranteed.

site.quiz3.note.zh: 打通流程不消除风险：合约交易仍可能亏损，强平、资金费率和执行风险都还在，生息利率会变，取回资金前需要先平仓。
site.quiz3.note.en: Connecting the flow doesn’t remove risk: futures trading can still lose money, liquidation, funding-rate and execution risk remain, yield rates change, and positions must be closed before funds can be withdrawn.

site.jy.fin.3.zh: 锁仓压住方向，兑现换出已实现，生息让闲钱计息，最后按净值对账。利率浮动，不承诺收益。
site.jy.fin.3.en: The hedge holds direction flat, closing the winner turns it into realised profit, the yield puts idle cash to work, and the net value settles the account. Rates float; no return is promised.

site.bn.a.2.en: Same price, one goes long, one goes short

site.bn.a.3.en: An opportunity, without betting on direction.

site.bn.a.4.zh: BTCUSDT 永续在 96,000。两只 Dodo 走上各自的柱子：绿旗开多 100 BTC，红旗开空 100 BTC（示意）。资金始终在你自己的币安子账户里。
site.bn.a.4.en: BTCUSDT perpetual at 96,000. Two Dodos step onto their pillars: the green flag opens a 100 BTC long, the red flag a 100 BTC short (illustrative). The money stays in your own Binance sub-account.

site.bn.a.5.zh: 对冲压低的是单边方向风险，不是全部风险。
site.bn.a.5.en: A hedge lowers one-way direction risk, not all risk.

site.bn.a.6.zh: 示意数据 · 非真实行情 · 不会下单
site.bn.a.6.en: Illustrative · not live market data · no orders placed

site.bn.b.2.zh:
K 线向右生长，
背后露出两边盈亏
site.bn.b.2.en:
The chart grows right;
behind it, both sides’ P&L

site.bn.b.3.zh: 一边赚多少，另一边就亏多少。
site.bn.b.3.en: What one side gains, the other loses.

site.bn.b.4.en: BTC climbs from 96,000 to 104,000: the long is up +800,000, the short down −800,000; net value is still 200,000.

site.bn.b.5.zh: 示意价格 · 非真实行情

site.bn.c.2.zh:
拔掉盈利的旗，
在新价位再插一面
site.bn.c.2.en:
Pull the winning flag,
plant a new one at the new price

site.bn.c.3.zh: 浮盈落袋成已实现，锁仓随即恢复。
site.bn.c.3.en: Floating profit becomes realised; the hedge is restored.

site.bn.c.4.zh: Dodo 爬上柱子平掉多头，+800,000 进入钱包：钱包余额从 200,000 变成 1,000,000。再在 104,000 开新多。空头的 −800,000 还在账上。
site.bn.c.4.en: Dodo climbs up and closes the long; +800,000 lands in the wallet: wallet balance goes from 200,000 to 1,000,000. A new long opens at 104,000. The short’s −800,000 is still on the books.

site.bn.c.5.zh: 钱包余额 1,000,000 ≠ 可用保证金，也不等于净值（仍约 200,000）。
site.bn.c.5.en: A 1,000,000 wallet balance ≠ free margin, and ≠ net value (still about 200,000).

site.bn.c.6.zh: 示意 · 净值 = 钱包余额 + 未实现盈亏
site.bn.c.6.en: Illustrative · net value = wallet balance + unrealised P&L

site.bn.d.2.zh:
可划转的那部分，
去稳定币生息区
site.bn.d.2.en:
The transferable part
goes to stablecoin yield

site.bn.d.3.zh: 托住持仓的保证金留下，其余才计息。
site.bn.d.3.en: Margin holding the positions stays; only the rest earns.

site.bn.d.4.zh: 示意划出 40,000 USDT。利息要随时间累计：演示按 4% 年化、1 秒约等于 1 天。
site.bn.d.4.en: Illustratively, 40,000 USDT moves out. Interest only builds up over time: the demo uses 4% a year, 1 second ≈ 1 day.

site.bn.d.5.zh: 具体产品与利率以上线时为准；利率浮动，不承诺收益。
site.bn.d.5.en: Actual products and rates are set at launch; rates float, no return is promised.

site.bn.d.6.zh: 示意 · 利息加速演示

site.bn.e.2.zh:
利息回到账上，
按净值对一遍
site.bn.e.2.en:
Interest comes back;
check it against net value

site.bn.e.3.zh: 只看钱包余额会高估，要看净值。
site.bn.e.3.en: The wallet balance alone overstates; look at net value.

site.bn.e.4.zh: 已实现 +800,000 与未实现 −800,000 相抵，这一轮真正多出来的是利息，再减去手续费与资金费率。
site.bn.e.4.en: Realised +800,000 and unrealised −800,000 cancel out; what this round really adds is the interest, minus fees and funding.

site.bn.e.5.zh: 两面旗都还插着：行情剧烈或保证金不足时，仍可能被强平。
site.bn.e.5.en: Both flags are still planted: in sharp moves or with too little margin, liquidation is still possible.

site.bn.f.2.zh:
每一轮多出来的一点，
慢慢铺满整片地面
site.bn.f.2.en:
What each round adds,
slowly covers the whole ground

site.bn.f.3.zh: 开仓锁住方向，上涨后兑现，可划转的部分去生息，按净值对账，再回到监测。金色只是示意“越来越多”，不代表真实收益；利率浮动，不承诺收益。
site.bn.f.3.en: Open hedged, take profit on the rise, send the transferable part to earn, reconcile by net value, then back to monitoring. The gold only illustrates “more over time”, not a real return; rates float and no return is promised.

site.bn.l.0.zh: 钱包余额<small>含已实现 +800,000 · 已划出 40,000</small>

site.bn.l.3.zh: 生息部分<small>本金 + 利息</small>

site.bn.l.cap.zh: 净值变化 = 已实现 +800,000 + 未实现 −800,000 + 利息 − 费用 · 示意数字，仅演示账目关系，不代表真实仓位或收益
site.bn.l.cap.en: Net change = realised +800,000 + unrealised −800,000 + interest − fees · illustrative figures showing how the books relate, not real positions or returns

site.bn.hold.en: Margin holding the positions stays in futures

site.bn.back.zh: 其他币种的监测一直在继续
site.bn.back.en: Monitoring of other coins carries on

site.hero.demo.en: Illustrative · demo data, not a live feed

site.st2.a.2.zh:
两只 Dodo 互踩一下，
一格变绿，一格变红
site.st2.a.2.en:
Two Dodos stomp each other,
one tile turns green, one turns red

site.st2.a.4.zh: BTCUSDT 永续在 96,000。两块黑格子升起，两只 Dodo 跳起来互踩一下：绿格子开多 100 BTC，红格子开空 100 BTC（示意）。资金始终在你自己的币安子账户里。
site.st2.a.4.en: BTCUSDT perpetual at 96,000. Two black tiles rise and the two Dodos jump and stomp each other: the green tile opens a 100 BTC long, the red tile a 100 BTC short (illustrative). The funds stay in your own Binance sub-account throughout.

site.st2.b.2.zh:
价格一动，
两块格子一升一降
site.st2.b.2.en:
When price moves,
one tile rises, one sinks

site.st2.b.4.zh: 先跌：红格子升、绿格子降；再涨到 104,000：绿格子升到 +800,000，红格子沉到 −800,000。净值仍是 200,000；地上的金砖一格一格加，是生息的利息。
site.st2.b.4.en: First a dip: the red tile rises, the green tile sinks. Then up to 104,000: green climbs to +800,000, red sinks to −800,000. Net value is still 200,000; the gold bricks added one by one on the ground are the interest.

site.st2.b.5.zh: 示意价格 · 非真实行情 · 金砖代表利息，演示按 4% 年化、1 秒约等于 1 天
site.st2.b.5.en: Illustrative prices · not live market data · gold bricks are interest, shown at 4% a year, about 1 second = 1 day

site.st2.c.2.zh:
绿色柱子降下来，
金砖向外扩散
site.st2.c.2.en:
The green column comes down,
gold spreads outward

site.st2.c.4.zh: Dodo 踩平多头：绿格子落回原位，+800,000 成为已实现，钱包余额从 200,000 变成 1,000,000。空头的 −800,000 还在账上。
site.st2.c.4.en: Dodo stomps the long closed: the green tile drops back, +800,000 becomes realized, and the wallet balance goes from 200,000 to 1,000,000. The short's −800,000 is still on the books.

site.st2.d.2.zh:
Dodo 再跳一下，
脚下又变成绿色
site.st2.d.2.en:
Dodo jumps once more,
the tile underfoot turns green

site.st2.d.3.zh: 在新价位重新锁住方向。
site.st2.d.3.en: Lock direction again at the new price.

site.st2.d.4.zh: 在 104,000 开新多 100 BTC，和空头再次相抵。可划转的部分（示意 40,000 USDT）留在生息区继续计息。
site.st2.d.4.en: A new 100 BTC long at 104,000 offsets the short again. The transferable part (illustrative 40,000 USDT) stays in the yield area earning interest.

site.st2.d.5.zh: 具体产品与利率以上线时为准；利率浮动，不承诺收益。
site.st2.d.5.en: Actual products and rates are set at launch; rates float and no return is promised.

site.st2.e.2.zh:
一格一格的金砖，
慢慢铺满整片地面
site.st2.e.2.en:
Brick by brick, the gold
slowly covers the whole ground

site.st2.e.3.zh: 已实现 +800,000 与未实现 −800,000 相抵，这一轮真正多出来的是利息，再减去手续费与资金费率。金色只是示意“越来越多”，不代表真实收益。
site.st2.e.3.en: Realized +800,000 and unrealized −800,000 cancel out; what this round really adds is the interest, minus fees and funding. The gold only suggests “more over time” — it is not a real return.

site.st2.e.5.zh: 多空两边都还开着：行情剧烈或保证金不足时，仍可能被强平。
site.st2.e.5.en: Both sides are still open: in a violent move or with too little margin, they can still be liquidated.

site.faq.sub.zh: 先把钱在哪、风险在哪、怎么取回问清楚。
site.faq.sub.en: Where the money sits, where the risk is, and how to get it back — answered first.
